cancelled_withdrawal_amount_before.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount recorded from the cancelled withdrawal's totalHypeValueReturned, read before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE resets it

cancelled_withdrawal_amount_after.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount after redelegateWithdrawnHYPE resets it to zero

redelegated_amount.meaning: HYPE amount actually re-delegated via _distributeStake with SpotDeposit (truncatedAmount sent to L1)

manager_caller.meaning: the caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE

assumptions: Only accounts holding MANAGER_ROLE can invoke redelegateWithdrawnHYPE.
The cancelled withdrawal amount is a positive HYPE value recorded before redelegation.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the dropped remainder stays in the contract's ETH balance or an L1 account, so the exact post-state location of the lost HYPE cannot be bound; the conservation relation is expressed at the amount level (redelegated_amount vs cancelled_withdrawal_amount_before).

limitations: The impact magnitude is bounded (< 1e10 wei per redelegation) but no concrete amount is given; the conservation relation is symbolic.
Permanent stranding and reduced kHYPE profits are downstream consequences handled in separate claim passes, not formalized here.
